mergeGuards.hit.note: HI-3284: one line a merge guard matched, in a returned card’s log: the file, the line number, and the line around the match (its own text).

mergeGuards.incomplete.text: the merge guards couldn't finish ({why}), so nothing was proved
mergeGuards.incomplete.note: HI-3284: what came back: the merge guards check could not finish: never a pass and never a match. {why}: mergeGuards.why.*.

mergeGuards.matched.text: merge guard "{guard}" matches {count, plural, one {a line} other {# lines}} it adds
mergeGuards.matched.note: HI-3284: what came back from a merge (the failure, after "came back:"): a merge guard (a pattern the project refuses in the lines a merge adds) matched. {guard}: its name. {count}: lines matched.

mergeGuards.matchedBy.note: HI-3284: one of several matching merge guards, in mergeGuards.matchedMany: its name and how many lines it matched.

mergeGuards.matchedMany.text: merge guards match lines it adds: {guards}
mergeGuards.matchedMany.note: HI-3284: as mergeGuards.matched, several guards. {guards}: each guard and how many lines it matched (mergeGuards.matchedBy), comma-joined.

mergeGuards.more.text: and {count, plural, one {# more line} other {# more lines}}
mergeGuards.more.note: HI-3284: past the lines listed, how many more a merge guard matched.

mergeGuards.todo.note: HI-3284: a matching merge guard and its message (the user’s own words: what to do instead), at the end of a returned card’s log.

mergeGuards.warning.text: Merge guards: {failure} since its merge base ({where}). The merge will refuse it if it is still there when merged.
mergeGuards.warning.note: HI-3284: cw_submit’s early warning (never a refusal): a merge guard matched what the submitted revision adds since its merge base with the target. {failure}: mergeGuards.matched or .matchedMany. {where}: the first file:line matched.

mergeGuards.warningIncomplete.text: Merge guards: couldn't check this revision ({why}); the merge checks them.
mergeGuards.warningIncomplete.note: HI-3284: cw_submit’s early warning when the merge guards could not be checked at submit. {why}: mergeGuards.why.*.

mergeGuards.why.failed.note: HI-3284: why the merge guards check could not finish: the thread that matches the guards ended unexpectedly.

mergeGuards.why.invalid.note: HI-3284: why the merge guards check could not finish: a guard’s pattern does not compile. {guard}: its name.

mergeGuards.why.malformed.text: the merge's changes couldn't be followed
mergeGuards.why.malformed.note: HI-3284: why the merge guards check could not finish: the diff the version control gave could not be parsed whole.

mergeGuards.why.matchesEmpty.note: HI-3284: why the merge guards check could not finish: a guard’s pattern matches the empty string (it would refuse every line). {guard}: its name.

mergeGuards.why.timedOut.text: guard "{guard}" ran past its time limit
mergeGuards.why.timedOut.note: HI-3284: why the merge guards check could not finish: a guard’s pattern ran past the time limit (Settings → Advanced). {guard}: its name.

mergeGuards.why.tooLarge.text: the merge adds more than the guards check
mergeGuards.why.tooLarge.note: HI-3284: why the merge guards check could not finish: the merge adds more text or lines than the limits (Settings → Advanced).

mergeGuards.why.unreadable.text: the merge's changes couldn't be read
mergeGuards.why.unreadable.note: HI-3284: why the merge guards check could not finish: the version control could not give the merge’s changes (a temporary failure).
